baseline_method: Run pinned upstream pytest tests with Python 3.13, pytest, freezegun; no source edits.
discovery_method: Existing discover() ranking and candidate criteria unchanged; add only generic support for src/ layouts and root-level tests
selection_method: Select source modules by exact test_<module>.py basename match, sorted lexicographically, all matches; select 2 function-level AST conditional mutants per eligible module by stable SHA-256 order; no hand-picked contract families or lines.
verification_method: Baseline original tests, then targeted test file against each mutation, classify detected/survived/invalid, restore source and verify Git tree. Original tests are not independent semantic specifications, so report test sensitivity only.
notes: Repo and commit selected before inspecting its source and prior to any trial execution
Target supports src/ layout which the original h11-specific CLI did not
No mutation of target remote or Git history is authorized
